create_process_transformers_detection_re: create a processed detection result dictionary from transformers post_process or post_process_detection output with boxes, labels, and scores
process_transformers_v4_segmentation_res: process transformers v4 segmentation results from post_process_panoptic, post_process_segmentation, or post_process_instance into masks and bounding boxes
process_transformers_v5_segmentation_res: process transformers v5 segmentation results from post_process_semantic_segmentation, post_process_instance_segmentation, or post_process_panoptic_segmentation
process_transformers_v5_semantic_or_inst: process transformers v5 semantic or instance segmentation results from segments_info and segmentation dictionary into masks and class IDs
process_transformers_v4_panoptic_segment: process transformers v4 panoptic segmentation results from png_string and segments_info into label masks and class IDs
convert_png_string_to_segmentation_array: convert a PNG byte string from panoptic segmentation into a label mask numpy array
append_class_names_to_data: append class names to a data dictionary by mapping class IDs through an id2label dictionary
